mapper.select: SELECT d.id, COALESCE(NULLIF(d.model, ''), NULLIF(d.manufacturer, ''), NULLIF(d.os, ''), '移动设备') AS display_name, d.os, d.os_version, COALESCE(history.first_login_time, d.crt_time) AS first_login_time, COALESCE(history.last_login_time, d.last_online_time) AS last_login_time, CASE WHEN #{currentDeviceId} IS NOT NULL AND d.device_id = #{currentDeviceId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_current, CASE WHEN d.trust_token_hash IS NOT NULL AND d.trust_revoked_at IS NULL AND (d.trust_expires_at IS NULL OR d.trust_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) THEN 'trusted' WHEN d.trust_revoked_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'revoked' WHEN d.trust_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND d.trust_expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 'expired' ELSE 'unverified' END AS trust_status FROM base_user_device d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT device_id, MIN(crt_time) AS first_login_time, MAX(crt_time) AS last_login_time FROM base_log_login WHERE crt_user = #{userId} AND client_type = #{clientType} AND deleted = FALSE AND device_id IS NOT NULL AND device_id <> '' GROUP BY device_id ) history ON history.device_id = d.device_id WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.client_type = #{clientType} AND d.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY COALESCE(history.last_login_time, d.last_online_time) DESC, d.id DESC
